newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot power prices down for milder Monday.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot power prices down for milder Monday.

text.p: Spot bulk power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were down Friday for Monday delivery with mild weather expected through the weekend and into early next week, industry sources said.
Forecasts called for Texas temperatures to be above normal through the weekend and Monday, with Sunday expected to be the warmest at 10 to 20 degrees Fahrenheit above normal.
ERCOT firm, peak power for a 16-hour block for Monday delivery was discussed at $21.00-23.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) from $26.00-28.00 on Thursday for Friday delivery, the sources said.
Non-firm on peak power for Friday delivery was pegged lower at $20.00-22.00, the sources said.

Firm off-peak Monday ERCOT deliveries were pegged at $15.00-17.00 from $21.00-23.00 on Thursday, while non firm off peak power was pegged at $13.00-15.00 from a notional Thursday assessment at $11.00-14.00 per MWh.
February ERCOT peak power was notionally assessed steady at $25.00-26.00, while March ERCOT peak power was notionally assessed steady at $20.50-21.00, the sources said.
